name: region-map
title: Region Map
description: A dotted world map with a marker per point, its count in a tooltip on hover, and zoom buttons, optionally headed by the top region and its three biggest parts. Tile-less: the land outline is bundled. Uses namespace exports: RegionMap.Root.

docs.lead: Every landmass as a dot pattern, with a marker wherever you pass a point. Hover a marker for its label and count; the buttons zoom, dragging pans. No tile provider or API key: the land outline ships with the component.
docs.usage:
import * as RegionMap from "@/components/ui/region-map"

<RegionMap.Root
  points={[{ label: "Location A", value: 120, lat: 43.65, lng: -79.38 }]}
  unit="Items"
/>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Points carry their own coordinates; turn a country or city into lat/lng before passing it. The map fills its container, so give the card a height.

examples.title: With top region
examples.description: Pass top to head the map with the leading place: its figure, a tag with its name and an optional image such as a flag, and a strip of its three biggest parts with their shares. Work out the shares before passing them; the map shows them as given.
examples.code:
<RegionMap.Root
  points={points}
  unit="Items"
  top={{
    label: "Top region",
    value: 120,
    name: "Region A",
    image: flagUrl,
    shares: [
      { label: "Location A", percent: 50 },
      { label: "Location B", percent: 30 },
      { label: "Location C", percent: 20 },
    ],
  }}
/>

api.name: RegionMap.Root
api.description: The map, its tooltip and its zoom buttons. Fills its container. Loads maplibre-gl in the browser, so it is safe to render on the server.

props.name: points
props.type: { label: string; value: number; lat: number; lng: number }[]
props.description: One marker per point. They can change after mount without resetting the view

props.name: unit
props.description: What the values count, beside the value in the tooltip

props.name: zoomInLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the zoom-in button

props.name: zoomOutLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the zoom-out button

props.name: top
props.type: { label: string; value: number; name: string; image?: string; shares: { label: string; percent: number }[] }
props.description: The leading place above the map: label is the caption over value, name and image make the tag, shares are its three biggest parts. Omit it for the bare map
